author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Forty-Nine! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Every once in a while we get a game across the desk here at GMG that's really trying to do something different. Today we're checking out one such game, In the Land of the Sundering Flood: a game dedicated to the works British of Arts & Crafts Movement icon Wiliam Morris. Can Game and Art collide? Let's dive in and find out!

Check out the rulebooks in digital  HERE: https://www.wargamevault.com/en/product/530715/in-the-land-of-the-sundering-flood-a-miniature-adventure-game-inspired-by-the-writings-of-william-morris?affiliate_id=210041
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 050 - In the Land of the Sundering Flood  by Nicolas Evans
